gate.contiguous_run_definition: successive gate rows separated by exactly 60 seconds

interpretation_limits: gate prevalence on one disturbed day is not a quiet-time false-positive rate
a nearby ACE or Wind gate does not prove that the spacecraft crossed the same discontinuity
the spacecraft are not co-located and no propagation correction is applied
GSE vector rotation is not a GSM clock-angle or geoeffectiveness claim
no shock, rotational discontinuity, current sheet, or flux-rope boundary is classified
no interpolation or forward fill is allowed
candidate support must report exact selected times and signed offsets
ephemeris and discontinuity-normal tests remain separately gated
